# ECS

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/ecs@v1.100.3` · last audited 2026-10-07 (`30db30dd8`)

### Known gaps

- Docker runtime container definition: firelensConfiguration and awsfirelens log routing (a task using either fails with TaskFailedToStart instead of starting the log router) and resourceRequirements (GPU) are stored but not applied; ephemeralStorage is validated (21 to 200 GiB) and reported on the task but not enforced on disk; awslogs-create-group is not enforced (the log group is always created) and the defaultLogDriverMode account setting is not consulted (non-blocking is always the default).
- Docker runtime: pidMode/ipcMode 'task' are not mapped ('host' and ipcMode 'none' are). Task-level cpu/memory bound every container (a container without a hard memory limit gets the task memory as its ceiling, NanoCPUs is the task vCPUs) but Docker has no task cgroup, so the sum across containers is not enforced. host and none network-mode containers cannot join the link-local credentials relay, and awsvpc tasks (pause container plus task network) are never adopted after an emulator restart. Managed EBS volumes: filesystemType is not applied (the Docker volume uses the local driver), volumeInitializationRate is echo only, and StartTask and ServiceRevision do not carry volumeConfigurations.
- Docker runtime dependsOn: the stoppedReason text for a failed dependency is unverified (no AWS doc publishes it; the task just moves to STOPPED per ContainerDefinition.startTimeout). Launch is asynchronous (PROVISIONING, PENDING, ACTIVATING, RUNNING); pullStartedAt/pullStoppedAt bracket the whole launch (no per-image pull timing), and PROVISIONING tasks in a restored snapshot are not resumed.
- ECS Exec: sessions exist only on the docker and kubernetes runtimes with the SSM service enabled (otherwise TargetNotConnectedException); the command runs as `sh -c <command>` through docker exec or pods/exec, and executeCommandConfiguration logging/KMS encryption and the ssmmessages IAM checks are not applied.
- Kubernetes runtime (CONTAINER_RUNTIME=kubernetes, docs/kubernetes.md): one Pod per task. Refused with TaskFailedToStart: host-path/EFS/configuredAtLaunch/shared-docker volumes, networkMode host/none, pidMode/ipcMode host, privileged, devices, container restartPolicy, repositoryCredentials, FireLens, dependsOn COMPLETE/HEALTHY; ulimits/ephemeralStorage ignored; dependsOn START is not ordered; a never-ready health check stays UNKNOWN; no security-group enforcement; tasks are not adopted after a restart.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- Service Connect: ServiceConnectConfiguration is stored and echoed, and ListServicesByNamespace matches on it, but Service Connect proxies and its Cloud Map instance registration are not modeled.
- Cloud Map registration of bridge/host-mode EC2 tasks: container instances have no modeled private IP, so only awsvpc tasks (ENI IP) are registered; tasks carry no placement AZ, so AVAILABILITY_ZONE is <region>a.
- AWS/ECS CPUUtilization/MemoryUtilization are emitted only for docker-runtime tasks; the noop runner has no container stats to measure.
- Daemon-launched tasks: ECS Managed Daemons run only on Managed Instances capacity providers, which provision EC2 hosts this emulator does not model, so ListTasks.daemonName filters correctly but no task ever belongs to a daemon.
- awslogs without awslogs-stream-prefix names the stream after the runtime container ID: exact under the docker runtime, but without a container runtime no container ID exists and the task ID stands in.
